title: Saved entries with partial-profit exits
notes: Each partial attempt adds one prior-median gas/MEV fee. Maximum possible fees are reserved before entry; actual fees depend on submitted orders. Sales fill after the signal and reaction delay, not at their target price. The entry-price and gross-principal floors do not cover fees. Drawdown tracks realized proceeds and remaining inventory. Unfilled fractions are written off after ten seconds; a partial timeout also marks the remaining position at zero at that instant for a conservative missing-price bound.
rule: Earlier saved entry, cohort gate and sizing profile remain fixed per day; only exit rule, size multiplier and daily full-loss budget are refit using earlier completed outcomes.
status: Retrospective. All evaluation dates were previously examined. This does not change the separately frozen validation rule.
